goals.notes: I believe in the AI revolution. I am a novice trader with not much history of success. I’d rather trade on high conviction stocks with strong growth outlooks, with some calibrated risks on stocks that could balloon, that tie into my belief in AI. I would rather not sink additional capital in if I don’t have to. I am okay to rebalance my portfolio to align with my goals. I can add capital if needed, but am already down 2 grand in loses this year. Don’t be afraid to make bold calls based on research and technicals that could find us a diamond in the rough type stock that explodes.

thesis: Own high-conviction AI leaders (NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MSFT, GOOGL) as multi-year compounders bought on weakness, funded by a rebuilt 16% cash pool from trimming over-concentrated semis, while keeping speculation (IREN) small, capped and on hard stops.
short_term: Trim ~$1,200 from over-extended AI-Infra overlap (AMD after +2.7%, some MU) to rebuild the 16% cash floor near $1,957 for dry powder.
Accumulate NVDA near $191 while the 200-day holds — RSI 43.5 is oversold and this is a core, years-long conviction, not a trade.
Buy the TSM dip (-4.3% today, RSI 49.5, uptrend) as your quality AI foundry, sizing to ~$183 risk against a defined stop.
Treat IREN as speculative: no adds on a -35% miner; hold it capped ≤8% and cut only on a volume close below recent lows.
Don't chase extended names — NET (RSI 67.6, +8.4% day) and AAPL (52-week-high zone) — add only on pullbacks toward trend.
MSFT stays a core hold, not a stop-out; accumulate small on dips toward support despite -11% P/L — the business thesis is intact.
long_term: Own NVDA, AVGO, TSM, MSFT, GOOGL and AMZN as multi-year compounders; add on weakness and never panic-sell great businesses on price alone.
With $0 new capital, compound by recycling trims and gains from extended names into core weakness, targeting the ~28% CAGR needed to reach $20,000.
Keep a small speculative sleeve (≤8%): IREN plus one optional runner like PATH (~$11.65), with defined size and hard stops for asymmetric upside.
Diversify AI beyond hardware into software and platforms (MSFT, GOOGL, NET, PANW/CRWD on pullbacks) so the book isn't all correlated semis at beta 1.83.
Manage concentration as the book grows: keep top-5 under ~45% and no single position above 10% of the portfolio.
guardrails: Risk ≤1.5% of book (~$183) per new entry; position size = risk dollars ÷ distance to your predefined stop.
Hold a 16% Cash & Income floor (~$1,957) and rebuild it before opening any new speculative position.
Cap the speculative sleeve at 8% and any single non-core name at 8%; keep no core position above 10%.
Never average down a broken speculative trade; cut IREN on a volume close below its recent lows.
If the S&P loses its 200-day or NVDA closes below $190, halve new size and raise cash to the floor.
milestones: By 2026-09-30: cash buffer rebuilt to ~$1,957 (16%) with book value holding at or above $13,000.
By 2027-01-31: portfolio ≥ $13,850 and IREN resolved — either recovered above -20% or cut per its stop.
By 2027-07-07: portfolio ≥ $15,650 (~28% CAGR pace) with top-5 concentration held under 45%.
By 2028-01-31: portfolio ≥ $17,700, each core compounder held 1+ year and still adding on weakness.
By 2028-07: reach the $20,000 two-year target with the AI core intact and speculation still ≤8%.
